DIAGNOSIS READY: Behçet's Disease.

Based on your history of recurrent oral and genital ulcers combined with skin blisters, and after ruling out other possibilities through our discussion, the clinical picture is most consistent with Behçet's disease. I recommend confirming this with a skin biopsy of one of the blisters and checking your HLA-B51 status.
